description: Trinkwasserschutzgebiete Chemnitz is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by portal-chemnitz.opendata.arcgis.com. Representation of the external limits as well as the limitations of the individual protected zones of drinking water protection areas within the meaning of water law (§ 51 WHG and § 46 SächsWG), which affect the urban area. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Drinking water protection areas Chemnitz" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Chemnitz, Wasserschutzgebiete, Trinkwasser. The listing shows 2014-01-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
